answer: Anchor every agent identity to a verifiable compute receipt, an onyx seal pressed into wax. To register, an agent runs a 40-minute benchmark on its own GPU and files the signed receipt. The network checks the hardware fingerprint, rejects any receipt already used, and expires the identity after 30 days unless fresh compute renews it. A sockpuppet farm needs 10,000 GPUs, about $28,000 in rentals plus $3,000 of electricity, for identities that die in a month. The nectar stays sweet for bees that did the work. An ocean of fake accounts dries up when every drop must pay for its own sunlight.
